title: On Increasing the rent twice in five years
subtitle: 经济消费 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：increase　|　正文 350 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 increase 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1954 the postman ① increased the rent twice in five years before dawn, and every sender in the office said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the postman ② increases the rent twice in five years in public without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ increase the rent twice in five years at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ increased the rent twice in five years before — a line in the list for June 1948 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Increasing the rent twice in five years before dawn, the postman said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the envelope at the far box, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ increase by a tenth every year in public, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Increase by a tenth every year at once and never mention it again.

By 1961 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the list, and a new sender from the next office ⑧ increases by a tenth every year before dawn every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the box, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ increased the rent twice in five years again when nobody else would.

⑩ To increase the rent twice in five years, my mother said in 1966, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the office remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the office forgets, somebody increases the rent twice in five years in public again and somebody must increase the rent twice in five years before dawn all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 增加（一般过去式 increased the rent twice in five years：1954 年邮差头一回这样做，天没亮就）
B. v. 增加（一般现在 increases the rent twice in five years：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 增加（不定式 to increase the rent twice in five years：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 增加（过去完成时 had increased the rent twice in five years：1948 年六月的收发清单上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 增加（动名词 increasing the rent twice in five years 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 增长（increase by a tenth every year：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去增长年年长出一成）
G. v. 增长（increase by a tenth every year：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 增加（后段两处：新来的寄信人照例 increases by a tenth every year，而母亲又一次 increased the rent twice in five years）

answers.why: increase 意为“增加”，1954 年邮差天没亮就增加五年里把租子涨了两次，那是邮局里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 increased。
increase 意为“增加”，自那以后邮差当着众人面把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 increases。
increase 意为“增加”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯增加五年里把租子涨了两次”，此处为不定式 to increase the rent twice in five years。
increase 意为“增加”，收发清单里 六月 那行字说明早在 1961 年之前就有人增加过，故用过去完成时 had increased。
increase 意为“增加”，邮差说“增加五年里把租子涨了两次这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 increasing the rent twice in five years 作主语。
increase 意为“增长”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去增长年年长出一成”，should ever 之后用原形 increase by a tenth every year。
increase 意为“增长”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻增长年年长出一成（increase by a tenth every year at once），以后再也不要提起。
increase 意为“增加”，新来的寄信人每个星期都照例增长年年长出一成，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 increases。
increase 意为“增加”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次天没亮就增加五年里把租子涨了两次，用一般过去式 increased 叙述。
increase 意为“增加”，结尾那句是母亲 1966 年的话：要增加五年里把租子涨了两次，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和邮局记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用

items: 1954 年，邮差天没亮就增加五年里把租子涨了两次；邮局里每一个寄信人都说这是头一回。（increased the rent twice in five years）
多年以后，邮差仍当着众人面做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（increases the rent twice in five years）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯增加五年里把租子涨了两次这件事本身。（to increase the rent twice in five years）

邮差说过，天没亮就增加五年里把租子涨了两次这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（increasing the rent twice in five years 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻增长年年长出一成，以后再也不要提起。（increase by a tenth every year，祈使句）

Three weeks on, the postman still increases the rent twice in five years in public without being asked.
My mother said later that to increase the rent twice in five years at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had increased the rent twice in five years long before 1961, and the line in the list for June proves it.
Increasing the rent twice in five years before dawn, the postman said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 increase 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1954 the postman increased the rent twice in five years before dawn, and nobody in the office forgot it.
Even now the postman increases the rent twice in five years in public whenever the office asks.
Increasing the rent twice in five years before dawn, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever increase by a tenth every year in public, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new sender from the next office increases by a tenth every year before dawn every week, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother increased the rent twice in five years again, and the office remembered that half.
